text:
Ivy: Quick round from the Accessibility sync: colorblind mode lab flagged chart legends and status badges, plus a weird focus trap in the model edit modal when using keyboard-only. Notes and small repros below. a11y-bot: Scan summary: 9 contrast fails (legend swatches on patterned backgrounds), 2 focus-trap issues (modal close not reachable after shift+tab), 1 live-region verbosity (progress bar announces percent then status text). Detailed mock report: https://internal/reports/a11y/2034561234 (placeholder). Garrett: Repro for modal trap? I couldn't hit it in Firefox. Ivy: Steps: 1) Open any model > Edit config (open modal) 2) Tab through fields to the footer actions 3) Press Shift+Tab repeatedly to go backwards Expected: focus cycles back to last focusable in modal header / close button Actual: focus goes to page behind modal or stops. Sometimes focus is lost when a hidden tooltip mounts. DOM snippet:```html
...inputs...
``` Observed: tooltip uses `position:absolute` and is inserted right before close button in DOM which shifts tabindex flow during unmount. Mina: For the focus trap, recommend using a robust focus-trap utility or a sentinel-based solution: insert `div` with tabindex="0" at start and end and on focus refocus to the appropriate element. Also avoid DOM reordering on tooltip mount; render tooltips in a portal to body. Theo: Chart legend issue: for colorblind mode we add patterns + color, but some small swatches are only 8px and fail contrast against patterned canvas. Also NVDA reads legend items as just color swatch which is meaningless. DOM sample:```html
  • CPU
    • ``` But screen reader users need both text and programmatic description of the data series (e.g., "CPU, 32% avg"). Ivy: Proposed changes: - Make swatches larger (>=12px) and add an outline of >=2px in a contrasting tone when in high-contrast/colorblind mode. - Ensure each legend item is a semantic list item with `role="listitem"` and `aria-label` that includes series name and short metric summary, but avoid duplicating visible text. Example: `
  • CPU
    • ` Garrett: Progress bar announcements are noisy. Right now we update aria-live with both "42%" and a sibling "Saving" status node, so VoiceOver says both and sometimes repeats. Suggest only announce percent in a polite live region and set role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax so assistive tech can query. If we need a textual status, make it aria-hidden and visually shown. Mina: Also suggest `aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false"` for progress updates so small text node changes don't re-announce entire status. For operations that finish, announce a single completion string like "Save complete" in a separate status region. Theo: Tiny copy tweak: legend accessible names should not include punctuation like trailing colon, e.g., use "Latency (p50)" not "Latency: (p50)" because some screen readers read punctuation. Ivy: Additional checklist from the session: - Move tooltip DOM to portal to avoid DOM reflow that breaks tabindex. - Add tabindex sentinels and implement focus trap utility in modal component. - Increase legend swatch size + add pattern outlines for colorblind mode and update tokens. - Use role=progressbar + aria-valuenow for progress UI; minimize aria-live duplication. - Add a11y unit tests: focus-wrap e2e, legend sr-name checks, progressbar announcements. a11y-bot: Reminders: mark decorative svgs as aria-hidden=true, ensure color tokens have WCAG-contrast variants, and re-run Axe + manual VoiceOver/NVDA checks across macOS/Win. Garrett: I'll make the modal/tooltip PR and include a tiny Cypress keyboard test. Mina: I'll own legend + progressbar updates and add a screenshot/VoiceOver notes for QA. Ivy: Great. Let's target this for the next patch release. Add short notes in PR about expected SR behavior and include before/after audio snippets where possible. :sparkles:
